ModMetaData.name: ISEKAI — Quick Quests [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Middle-click an ISEKAI quest letter to accept it without opening the quest tab when no decision is needed. FEATURES • Accepts available, unambiguous quests from ISEKAI and its Guild/Creatures add-ons. • Opens the normal quest tab if a pawn, option or reward must be selected, requirements are unmet, or the quest prevents automatic acceptance. Already accepted quests also open normally. • Leaves non-ISEKAI quests and other mouse buttons unchanged. HOW TO USE Middle-click the quest letter on the right side of the screen. The shortcut is enabled by default and can be turned off in RimWorld’s Mod Settings. Quick Quests has its own settings and works independently of Balanced Stats. COMPATIBILITY Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077) and ISEKAI RPG LEVELING (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3657580708). Load after these dependencies and any Guild/Creatures add-ons. English and Russian interface text is included. Use ISEKAI — Balanced Stats (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3789339468) 1.2.0 or later when using both mods. Quick Quests stores no colony save data and can be added to or removed from an existing save. Original ISEKAI files are neither included nor modified. FEEDBACK Found a bug or an inaccuracy? Leave a comment on the mod page or on Boosty. Preview artwork: POUPUN / ISEKAI RPG LEVELING.
